generated_from.note: The AES git commit is deliberately not embedded. The consumer pins the AES commit and this file's sha256.
generated_from.profile_version_semantics: <manifest_version>+<aes_commit>; the consumer supplies aes_commit from its own pin

value.description: Artifact profile id, namespaced by modality: `text/article`, `visual/body-infographic`, `audio/dialogue`. The modality prefix is what keeps text, visual, and audio generation contracts separate.

audience_axis.description: Audience is the one axis shared by every modality: it changes explanation depth in text, information density in visuals, and pace and assumed knowledge in audio. A preset plus task-specific trait overrides, never a rigid bucket.

traits.description: Task-specific deviations from the preset. Only traits that materially change delivery belong here — demographics that change nothing are ceremonial and are omitted.

life_stage.description: Recorded only when it materially affects communication — a child audience changes vocabulary and example choice; an age number that changes nothing does not belong here.

basis.description: Why this value. For `confirmed`, the span of the utterance or the upstream contract that fixed it. For `assumed`, the inference. Required in practice for audit; a value with no basis cannot be routed when it turns out wrong.

profile_ref.description: Repository path of the resolved profile. Absent when unresolved.

value.description: Profile id within the matching axis directory under editorial/profiles/. null only when state is missing_material.

options.description: Choices with a marked default beat an open prompt. A clarification with no options is a defect unless the field genuinely has an open range.

reference_input.description: Material that can inform craft. Carries no factual authority: an evaluation of a reference may never become a verified claim.

dimensions.description: Which dimensions of this reference the human actually wants applied. `이 reference는 정보 구조는 좋은데 색감은 싫어` becomes dimensions plus a task override, not wholesale imitation.

resolution_state.description: confirmed: the human said it, or an authoritative upstream contract did — the only state that may inform durable calibration. assumed: safely inferred for this run; never durable preference evidence. missing_material: absent and materially outcome-changing.

source_input.description: Material that can establish fact. Referenced by id and never copied into this repository.

schema.description: The structured result of natural-language intake (AES-V2.1 / SUE-559) expressed over five independent axes (AES-V2.2 / SUE-560). A human writes sentences; an agent writes this. Every axis value carries a resolution state, and only `confirmed` values may ever inform durable calibration.

axes.description: The five independent axes. They do not collapse into one another: a transformation is not a content type, a surface is not an audience, an artifact is not a style.

artifacts.description: One or more requested artifacts. Empty means the artifact axis is still unresolved and must appear in clarification.required.

calibration_ref.description: The calibration version active at intake (AES-V2.10). Recorded so a later verdict can be attributed to the calibration that produced it rather than to whichever is current.

clarification.description: The exception path. Questions are asked only when a missing field would materially change thesis, audience fit, transformation fidelity, artifact route, publication constraint, or cost.

asked.description: Normally 0-3 entries. An intake that asks four or more questions has failed its own gate and must record why in `note`.

required.description: Axis or constraint paths currently in state `missing_material`. Non-empty forces status `blocked_on_clarification`.

resolution.description: proceeded: nothing material was missing. answered: the human supplied the missing values. default_authorized: the human said `알아서 해` / `use default`, which authorizes `assumed` for this run and nothing beyond it. unresolved: still blocked.

max_source_age_days.description: Freshness ceiling when the request is time-sensitive. Absent means the content-type profile decides.

inputs.description: Source and Reference are separate lists because they are separate kinds of authority. A reference can never establish a fact; a source can never dictate a composition.

intent_id.description: Stable id for this intake. Lineage anchor: every downstream frame, plan, artifact, and feedback record cites it.

overrides.description: Values the human set for THIS RUN only. Task-scoped by construction — an override is never durable preference, and V2.10 calibration may not read this array.

request.description: What the human actually said, kept verbatim. The intake is auditable only if the utterance survives next to its interpretation.

language.description: BCP-47 language of the request itself. Not the output language — that is constraints.output_language.

received_by.description: Agent runtime that performed intake, e.g. `claude-code`, `chatgpt`. Recorded so an intake defect can be attributed.

status.description: ready: the intent may drive framing/planning. blocked_on_clarification: at least one material field is unresolved. declined: intake refused the request and recorded why in clarification.note.

schema.title: Editorial Intent

routing.description: Which layer (docs/architecture/V2-EDITORIAL-LEARNING-CORE.md §5) produced the failure or success this feedback names. Abstention must be expressible: layer null with abstained true says the record could not tell rather than guessing.

abstained.description: True when this record cannot name a layer with confidence.

modality_layer.description: Modality-specific routing detail, e.g. a TEXT/VISUAL/AUDIO sub-concern. Free text; the shared layer above is the enumerated one.

schema.description: One append-only record of human or agent feedback on a generated output (AES-V2.3 / SUE-561). Distinct from a reference evaluation: this judges what the system produced, not third-party material. See docs/architecture/V2-EDITORIAL-LEARNING-CORE.md §5 (layers) and §6 (four separate signals, never averaged).

basis.description: explicit_human_feedback: the human said it. model_inference: an agent judged it.

evidence_links.description: Ids of other feedback or evaluation records this one corroborates. Required (non-empty) when scope is calibration_candidate — a single record, human- or agent-authored, never promotes itself; it must point at the repeated independent evidence it joins. AES-V2.10 still owns the actual promotion.

owner_verdict.description: Distinct from verdict: whether the owner actually accepted the output, not the evaluator's read of its quality. unknown is the required default when no owner acceptance/rejection has actually been expressed — it is never omitted and never inferred as accepted from publication, an L1 pass, silence, or time passing.

scope.description: task_local (the safe default) or calibration_candidate. A single record may never be calibration_candidate on its own basis alone — see references/REFERENCE-EVALUATION-PROTOCOL.md and AES-V2.10, which owns promotion into durable calibration.

signal.description: The four V2 signals stay separate and are never averaged into one score.

statement.description: What the human actually said, verbatim where possible.

ref.description: Id or path of the generated thing this feedback is about.

schema.title: Feedback record

schema.description: Video narration extension of SUE-566 audience-aware audio profiles. Draft and correct text before pronunciation planning and TTS.
schema.title: Narration Script

claim_set.description: Authoritative article claim identity. The article_ref claims_hash binds this declared set to the upstream article version.

information_hierarchy.description: Integrated reader hierarchy that must remain coherent with the selected reference authority.

publication_display_surfaces.description: Authoritative publication-display geometry for the full and mobile surfaces. These are RenderSpec declarations, not review assertions.

text_ownership.description: The three V2.17 ownership classes. Verified generative facts carry a canonical payload, source lineage, and mandatory post-render verification.

verified_generative_fact.description: Null explicitly represents that this ownership class has no items; an object declares generated facts that require authoritative payload lineage and post-render verification.

watermark.description: Optional, default-OFF deterministic watermark overlay on a flattened PNG (SUE-1303). Every field is optional so a profile default, a RenderSpec, and an account/channel override can each set only what they change; omitted fields resolve to the defaults in scripts/lib/watermark-core.mjs (enabled=false). Glyphs are composited by the renderer, never drawn by an image model. This is not the accidental-watermark detection in editorial/IMAGE-GENERATION.md.

enabled.description: Defaults to false (OFF). OFF is a byte-identical no-op.

exclusion_zones.description: Layout-declared regions (numbers, charts, small text) the watermark must not touch, as image fractions. If the watermark box intersects one, the derivative is not produced.

placement.description: Horizontal placements only. Diagonal is deliberately not allowed: it crosses content, which the exclusion-zone rule forbids.

safe_margins.description: Fractions of image height (bottom) and width (left/right).

scale.description: Font size as a fraction of image width.

schema.description: Durable renderer-neutral scene/composition contract for a Visual Brief.

crop_anchors.description: Semantic anchors that a publication crop may preserve. Review records may select only one of these declared anchors.

claim_set.description: Authoritative article claim identity. The article_ref claims_hash binds this declared set to the upstream article version.

information_hierarchy.description: Integrated reader hierarchy. The primary takeaway is visually dominant; supporting and detail text are subordinate.

text_ownership.description: The three V2.17 ownership classes. Verified generative facts carry a canonical payload, source lineage, and mandatory post-render verification.

verified_generative_fact.description: Null explicitly represents that this ownership class has no items; an object declares generated facts that require authoritative payload lineage and post-render verification.

schema.description: Durable editorial semantics for a generative or hybrid visual. Provider prompts are compiled outputs, never this authority.

dark-data.generation_direction: High-contrast dark editorial composition with restrained mint accents. Illustration supports rather than competes with evidence. Never invent KPI tiles, chart marks, performance percentages, or product brands.

editorial-minimal.generation_direction: Restrained magazine composition; generous negative space; one clear subject; quiet material texture. No ornamental mini dashboards or icon grids. Typography remains in reserved compositor regions.

theme.font_family: 'Noto Serif CJK KR', 'Noto Serif KR', Georgia, serif

pop-collage.generation_direction: Expressive paper collage with pink/orange/blue accents, torn edges, playful brush texture and one dominant silhouette. Restrict collage to its supplied content slot; no factual copy, faux numbers, logos, robot cliches or unrelated slogans unless specifically requested.

recipes.scope: Task-selected realization presets, not a new intent axis or a replacement brand/reference authority. No factual payload or approval.
